label: Diagram 4.2
caption: Diagram 4.2 Maximum travel distances in a small three storey premises with a single open stair
description:
The drawing, footed "Diagram 4.2 Maximum travel distances in a small three storey premises with a single open stair", carries "See para 4.6" top left. It contains two square plan outlines and a notes block.

The upper plan, captioned "Basement or first storey", has small circles at its two upper corners. Two green lines run from those corners inward to meet at a hatched rectangle at the bottom edge; each line is labelled "18m max."

The lower plan, captioned "Ground storey", shows a single green line from the upper right corner to the lower left, labelled "27m max." A hatched rectangle sits near the bottom edge and an open door symbol appears at the lower left. A dimension "3m max." spans the lower left between the door and a small circle.

To the right, under "NOTES:", four numbered lines read: "1. Maximum floor area in any one storey 90m²." "2. The premises may not be used as a restaurant or bar." "3. Only acceptable in two storey premises (first + ground storey or basement + ground storey)." "4. Travel distances are set out in Table 4.1."
